literal_meaning: জুতোর মতো সই (shoe-fitting or suiting like a shoe)
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই জামাটা আমার জন্য জুতসই নয়।
example_sentences_in_english: This shirt is not suitable for me.
The meal didn't sit well with me.
note: Derived from the concept of a shoe fitting well, extended metaphorically to general suitability in Bengali usage.
